criteria.passage: I’d tell them I understand why they want a firm date, but we’re still waiting on the technical team to confirm what’s causing it and when it can be fixed.
criteria.rationale: The candidate clearly explains the situation in understandable terms, including why a firm date cannot yet be given.

criteria.passage: I wouldn’t want to promise something I can’t back up.
criteria.rationale: This explicitly avoids unsupported promises and communicates only what is currently justified by the available information.

criteria.passage: I’d let them know I’m continuing to track it and will update them when I have confirmed information. I’d keep the case open and make sure it stays with the team until there’s more to share.
criteria.rationale: The candidate proposes an ongoing follow-up mechanism through continued tracking, updates upon confirmation, and keeping the case open with the team.
